elder.summary: Old Bram. The oldest man in Hearthmere. He sits by the well and watches who comes down the road, and says less than he knows.

about.elda: Feeds half the village and scolds the other half. Her boy is with the levy. Don't ask her about him unless you mean to listen.
about.lina: Counts other people's coin and calls it trade. She was not always so. Debt does that.
about.mira: Runs the Guild while Corwin drinks it. She came here at eight years old with nothing. Ask her where from and watch her smile go flat.
about.garrick: A tired man doing two men's work. Tired men look the other way. Remember that.
about.smith: Tess. Her husband went to the salt pits to pay a debt. Three years. She still sets two cups.
about.kai: One of yours. Thinks none of this is real. The day he learns better, somebody else will pay for the lesson.
about.sora: Another of yours, and the only one who reads. She asks me about the old stones. I tell her less than she'd like.
about.wren: Good hands, old fear. She left the Church, and the Church does not like to be left.

barks.text: Well's low. It was never low in my day.
Sit, if you're sitting. Standing makes the ale nervous.

elda.summary: Elda the baker. Up before the sun, feeds anyone who looks thin, and has opinions about all of them. Her son Jory serves in the margravine's levy.

about.elder: Bram was old when I was a girl. He knows every grave in the yard by name. Bring him bread and he pretends he didn't want it.
about.pip: Good boy. Works that farm like it was three of him. His father owes the Company and thinks nobody knows.
about.lina: She sells flour at a price that makes me want to spit in it. But she pays on the day. I'll say that.
about.garrick: He eats here every morning and has not paid since the thaw. I let him. Somebody has to stand at that gate.
about.smith: Tess keeps her fire lit and her mouth shut. I'd take one of her over ten of most people.

barks.text: First loaves are out! Don't all stand there.
You're thin. Everyone who falls here is thin.

smith.summary: Tess, who keeps the forge. Her husband Orrin was bonded to the Saltdeeps three years ago for a debt. She has had no word since.

about.lina: Ask her what a husband costs. She'll have the figure.
about.elda: She leaves a loaf on my anvil when she thinks I'm not eating. I'm not, mostly.
about.elder: He sits. He watches. When my Orrin was taken he was the only one who said it was wrong, out loud, in the square.
about.garrick: He was at the gate the day they took Orrin through it. He opened it.

barks.text: Iron's dear this year. Ask the goblins where it all goes.

lina.summary: Lina, who trades from the stall by the square. Everything she sells comes through the Halveth Company, and so does everything she owes.

about.smith: Tess blames me for a contract her husband put his own mark to. I only carried the paper.
about.elder: The old man thinks the village ran better before coin. It ran hungrier.
about.garrick: A reasonable man. Reasonable men are worth cultivating.
about.wren: She undersells the Company's tonics and thinks nobody in East Watch has noticed. Somebody has.
about.elda: She would give the bakery away loaf by loaf if nobody stopped her.

barks.text: Company goods, Company prices. Fresh off the East Watch road.

wren.summary: Wren the alchemist, with a stall by the Guild road. She trained under the Church of the Pale Lantern and left without leave.

about.mira: She gave me this pitch when nobody else would rent to a woman with no past. I don't forget it.
about.lina: She has asked twice where I learned my craft. She smiles when she asks.
about.sora: She brings me rubbings from the old stones and asks what the marks do. I tell her the truth: I was never taught that far.
about.elder: He looks at my hands, not my face. He knows whose hands were trained like these.

barks.text: Red for wounds. Don't drink two at once, whatever Kai says.

garrick.summary: Garrick, the village guard. One man for a gate, a road and the nights. He takes what he is offered, and he is offered things.

about.kai: Your kind die and get up again. He acts like it. One night he'll start something in that yard that a village man has to finish.
about.elda: Best bread in the March. I owe her since the thaw. She hasn't asked.
about.lina: Pays her dues, keeps her stall tidy. I don't ask what's in the crates. That isn't my post.
about.smith: She hasn't spoken a civil word to me in three years. She has her reasons.
about.elder: Knows more than he says. Lets you find out the hard way.

barks.text: Road's quiet. I like it quiet.
Nights are long at this gate.

pip.summary: Pip of Harrow Farm. Works the fields with his father Hamm, and keeps a pitchfork by the door since the goblins grew bold.

about.elda: She used to give me the burnt ends when I was small. Still does. Don't tell her I said still.
about.garrick: He's one man. One. You count the goblins and tell me that's enough.
about.elder: Da says Old Bram fell out of the sky same as you, and Bram says Da talks too much.

barks.text: Walk past the sheep, don't run. They bolt.

mira.summary: Mira, receptionist of the Hearthmere Guild, who runs it in all but name. Cheerful with everyone. She came to the village as a child, from the north.

about.hollis: Twenty years with the Company before he came to us. He reads a ledger the way priests read scripture.
about.kai: He brings in more crystals than anyone and more trouble than the rest together.
about.sora: She pays her dues and asks for the keys to the old records. I've stopped asking why.
about.wren: The best alchemist this side of East Watch, and she charges like the worst. Buy from her.
about.elder: Bram found me on the north road when I was eight. He has never once asked me about it.

hollis.summary: Hollis, the Guild's appraiser. Kept the Halveth Company's books in East Watch for twenty years before he came to Hearthmere.

about.mira: She adds faster than I do and pretends she doesn't. Sensible girl.
about.lina: She trades on Holt's paper. I wrote that paper for twenty years. I know what the small script says.
about.kai: Brings me pelts hacked to ribbons and argues the price. Every time.

kai.summary: Kai, a Lightborn who fell a year ago. A fine swordsman who treats the world as a game he is winning.

about.sora: She thinks there's a way home. I tell her this is the better server. She doesn't laugh.
about.garrick: Level nothing, guards a gate. Why do they even give him a name?
about.mira: Best quest-giver in the zone. I mean that as a compliment. She doesn't take it as one.

barks.text: Next round's on whoever died last. Not me, then.

sora.summary: Sora, a Lightborn who fell a year ago. She studies the old Auren stones and believes there is a way back.

about.kai: He stopped counting the days. I think that is how it gets you.
about.wren: She was taught to read part of the old script and forbidden the rest. She helps me anyway.
about.elder: He answers my questions with questions. But they are always the right questions.

nell.summary: Nell of Westwood, bonded to the Halveth Company for her father's debt of fifteen crowns. She was in the cage with you.
